run_d360_compressed_publisher: run the ROS 2 node that captures from a Digit 360 camera and publishes H.264 encoded video
create_CompressedCameraPublisher: create a CompressedCameraPublisher node that encodes camera frames to H.264 using NVIDIA NVENC and publishes CompressedVideo messages
review_publish_frame: review the publish_frame method that converts BGR frames to NV12, encodes via NVENC, and publishes H.264 bitstreams
refactor_CompressedCameraPublisher_init: refactor the CompressedCameraPublisher init to support configurable resolution, bitrate, and encoding preset parameters
test_destroy_node: test the destroy_node method that releases the camera capture device and shuts down the ROS 2 node
